snippet.title: Commodore 64 Longplay [133] The Neverending Story (EU)
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: MadMatty

The Neverending Story, developed by Ian Weatherburn and published by Ocean in 1985

"A BOY WHO NEEDS A FRIEND FINDS A WORLD THAT NEEDS A HERO"

The Story
---------
The computer game follows the main theme of the film and is set in "Fantasia", a world of the imagination facing extinction by the "All consuming Nothing", eroding its very fabric and condemning it to oblivion. It is in desperate need of a hero from the "Real World", someone to believe in it and thus renew its life.

That someone is a small boy, Bastian Balthazar Bux, who discovers a dusty old book on the shelves of an antique bookshop. The title is "The Neverending Story" and it chronicles the ever changing fortunes of the people of "Fantasia". Bastian takes the book and blowing the dust from its jacket reveals the front cover depicting "Auryn" the silver and gold medallion symbolizing the strength of "Fantasia". On reaching school he avoids his teachers, climbs into an abandoned attic and setting himself down on an old rug begins to read the compelling tale.

The many peoples of "Fantasia" are gathered to seek audience with their Empress, but are dismayed to find her ill and weak. "Cairon", the physician gives them encouragement, telling of a hero, a small boy from the plains by the name of Atreyu - the only person who can find the savior of "Fantasia". In the game you take the part of Atreyu and only through your endeavors will the kingdom be restored to its former glory!"

The game is a well presented and short (only if you know the solution) text adventure which ties in with the movie of the same name. The C64 game is a multiload in 3 parts. The game is quite colorful compared with the Spectrum version but here the music is only on the title screen and not played throughout making this version a little less interesting to play. A small issue might be picking up of 'The Shiny Object' at the start. Unless you have read the instructions or know that it is 'Auryn' (needed to command Falkor) you might not know to pick it up.
